purpose: Teach: 総体/元祖/置き場/アウトソーシング/空調/積立/延べ/一様

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究領域の総体を捉えろ
lines.en: Ren — grasp the full scope of your research field.
lines.style: Calm, measured delivery. Clear-eyed authority without harshness. Slight pause after the name, letting the instruction land. The tone of someone who expects you to rise to it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。当分野の元祖と言える論文を読みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll start by reading the foundational papers in the field.
lines.style: Attentive and earnest. Lean slightly forward on the opening. Thoughtful pace — he's already thinking through the work. Respectful but not deferential.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究器材の置き場を整理しろ
lines.en: Ren — organize the equipment storage in the lab.
lines.style: Direct, practical instruction. No flourish. Brief eye contact that says this matters. Efficient pacing, like ticking off a list of things that need doing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。データ分析のアウトソーシングも検討します
lines.en: Yes. I'll also look into outsourcing the data analysis.
lines.style: Quick, nodding-along agreement on the first word. Then a beat of thought — he's already planning the next step. Slightly faster second half, eager to show initiative.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室の空調管理にも気を配れ
lines.en: Ren — pay attention to the lab's climate control as well.
lines.style: Calm, measured. A gentle broadening of scope — not criticism, just adding another thing to care about. Slight softening in tone. The 'as well' suggests this is about building responsibility, not just checking boxes.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の積立計画を立てます
lines.en: Yes. I'll also draw up a plan for the research budget allocation.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Slight hesitation before the second thought — he's reaching beyond what was asked, showing he understands the scope. Careful, considered pacing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、延べ被験者数を確認しろ
lines.en: Ren — verify the total number of research participants.
lines.style: Sharp, direct. The tone has shifted subtly — this is more specific, more methodological. Eye contact steady. A genuine instruction, not busywork.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。被験者に一様な処遇を提供します
lines.en: Yes. I'll ensure all participants receive consistent and fair treatment.
lines.style: Quiet commitment. The word 'ensure' carries weight — he understands this is ethical, not just procedural. Slow, deliberate pace. Small exhale at the end, like settling into something important.
